facts.fact: Santiago Calatrava designed the pedestrian swing bridge at Dock 3 in Puerto Madero.
It links the Alicia Moreau de Justo side with Olga Cossettini.
The official interpretation relates its form to a tango couple.

title: Turismo Buenos Aires — Puente de la Mujer
